items.q: The transcript only contains a note clarifying the spelling of the name 'MR. KOULOVARIS' and does not contain any dialogue or narrative from the interviewee describing a personal or professional relationship with this individual.

ctx.x: It's like that story about the writer Bemelmans he used to have this babysitter who was a child kidnapper. And he said, how could you leave your child with this known criminal? He said, I know that every policeman in Paris is watching him. I know she's as safe as she could possibly be. I figured with Sonny, my daughter's safe, all the cops had an eye on him.
MR. KOULOVARIS (PHONETIC) was his last name.
